.pmp.description: Object placement list for a golf course stage. Each object has a type id, a position, a scale and a 3x3 rotation matrix. No object names are stored.
.pmp.structure: BE. 0x00 "PMPF"; 0x10 u16 object count; 0x40 u32 table offset (0x80); 0x44 u32 = file size (observed). Records are 0x58 bytes from table offset: +0x00 u16=1; +0x02 u16 object type id (0..19 observed); +0x04 u8 variant flag (0 = all, 1 = variant-specific, filter in RPUtlMapData.cpp FUN_801bf564/5e4); +0x08 f32 x,y,z (position, world units, matches KCL); +0x14 f32 x3 scale; +0x20/+0x2c/+0x38 three 3-float vectors = 3x3 rotation matrix rows (det = +/-1 observed); +0x44 s32 = -1 (parent, always none); +0x48 u16 x4 unknown.
.pmp.confidence: high (structure, record stride and count verified against decompiled loader and file sizes; positions fall in the KCL bbox); medium (rotation/scale semantics); low (meaning of type ids: no names in file)

.plight.description: Light set for a stage (ambient/colour fields plus LOBJ light blocks).
.plight.structure: BE. "LGHT" + u32 size (= file size, 1352 = 0x548 in all 21 files). Header of 0x48 bytes, then 16 LOBJ slots of 0x50 bytes each (72 + 16*80 = 1352; LOBJ tags at 0x48, 0x98, ...). Slot fields partly seen: a block at +0x60 holds 3 floats (-10, 10.5, 10.5 in glf_scene_fc1) that look like a position or direction; meaning not verified. Header RGBA words at 0x18.. (a0a0a0ff, 4a371aff, 646464ff).
.plight.confidence: medium-high (container, size and 16-slot layout); low (field semantics)

.plmap.description: Lightmap set: references lightmap textures by name (lm_0, lm_1) which are BTI files in the shared common.carc.
.plmap.structure: BE. "LMAP" + u32 size (= file size, 408 for glf_scene_fc1). Then LTEX block (size 0xBC, holds name "lm_0") and LOBJ blocks (0x50). Texture names resolve to lm_0.bti / lm_1.bti.
.plmap.confidence: medium (container and name refs, sizes match); low (per-field semantics)

.pblm.description: Bloom parameters for the scene (values such as 0.1, -1, 0.2, 0.0 floats).
.pblm.structure: BE. "PBLM" + u32 size (=0xA4 = 164 in golf and boxing files; size matches file size). Only partially decoded: float at 0x10 (0.1 in golf, 0.4 in tennis scene_Bloom), further floats at 0x40 and 0x60; the meaning of the other fields is unknown.

.pmmisc.description: Misc model/material list for shared minigame environments (e.g. golf). Holds names such as M_Bunker_v, M_Green_v, M_Kiwa_v, M_map_tree1_v(2).
.pmmisc.structure: BE. "MMSC" + u32 size (= file size, 420 for golf). Followed by variable-size entries of name strings and float triples; some names are split by stray bytes in the raw data, so names are extracted with regex. Entry layout NOT verified.

.rcd.description: Fixed 74-byte record per CPU Mii (cpu_mii_000..059.rcd); fits the 0x4A-byte Wii Mii character data size. Name is UTF-16BE at 0x02 (10 chars). The rest (face/hair/body data) not decoded.
.rcd.structure: 74 bytes; u16 at 0x00 unknown; UTF-16BE name at 0x02..0x15.
.rcd.confidence: medium (size and name field verified on samples; not a stage file)

.bti.description: GX texture container: format byte, dimensions, mip count, data offset 0x20.
.bti.structure: 0x00 u8 GX format (0=I4,1=I8,2=IA4,3=IA8,4=RGB565,5=RGB5A3,6=RGBA8,8=CI4,9=CI8,10=CI14X2,14=CMPR); 0x01 u8 alpha; 0x02 u16 width; 0x04 u16 height; 0x14/0x15 filters; 0x18 u8 mip count; 0x1C u32 data offset (=0x20). Size validated against block sizes for all 10 files.

.bmg.description: Text message archive (Nintendo BMG, bmg1): INF1 message table + DAT1 text.
.bmg.structure: "MESG" "bmg1" u32 file size, u32 section count (3), then sections INF1 (message table), DAT1 (text) and MID1 (message ids). Text not extracted.
.bmg.confidence: high (magic/section tags); low (text decoding not attempted)

.bin.description: 4 game data tables: cpuData.bin (BE u32 table, 2400 bytes), TrialData.bin ("BWCH" + build timestamp string "Wed Sep 06 09:48:23 2006"), GateChallengeData.bin (same kind), BowExcelGlobal.bin (BE float table).
.bin.structure: Not decoded beyond the header. Not related to stage placement.
